title: Follow the logic of a new text
instructions: Read the whole text, then choose the pair of words for both gaps.

parts.prompt: The team’s first design failed the water test. ___, they changed the seal and tested it again. The second design held, ___ the leak did not return.

choice_rationales.A: Changing the seal is not a surprise after a failure, and unless sets a condition the text does not contain.
choice_rationales.B: The change is not an example of the failure, and the missing leak does not explain why the design held.
choice_rationales.C: Failing and changing the seal are not similar, and although wrongly shows a contrast.
choice_rationales.D: Therefore shows that the failure led to the change, and and adds a second piece of good news.

parts.hint: Check each gap against the sentence around it.
parts.correct_explanation: The failure led to the change, and the two good results then go together.
